name: tegy-openai
description: Independent strategy-draft review that may automatically consume Tegy allowance at an interview decision checkpoint.

interface.shortDescription: Independent review of a supplied strategy draft
interface.longDescription: Submit one strategy draft, its original brief, and optional bounded evidence to Tegy for an independent adversarial review. In a strategy interview, one allowance-consuming review may run before the client revises its provisional answer and concludes.
